excluded: All incenses scenes and catnip; separately completed and repaired.
limits: Bounded editor preview only, not Bedrock shader, alpha culling, emissivity, gameplay, connection or growth mechanics.
336 plant faces retain known ±0.08 offsets / 0.16 native thickness, not exact geometry.
Magenta retains known Forge/native 47 versus NeoForge/JAR 35 face branch divergence.

Orthographic camera angles intentionally remain oblique to expose different Z rows without frontal overlap; both sides of leaf/light sheets are reviewed, with extra undersides for horizontal vine sheets.
This review does not reopen or supersede incense repair; does not include wild vines, boards, devices, particles, native gameplay or other unassigned families.
capture_method: Every evidence image is the unmodified JPEG byte array returned by app.getScreenshot({emit:false}), emitted for actual visual inspection and written from the same local variable. No render, crop, stitch or reencode.
final_gui_state: Own read-only scene tabs closed without saving; window 44040196 verified New Tab and no modal. GUI handed to OTC; other windows and terminals untouched.
